name: S1 空列表 key
code:
print(sorted([], key=lambda x: x))
xs = [2, 1]
print(sorted(xs, key=lambda x: x))

name: S2 嵌套 sorted key
code:
xs = [3, 1, 2]
print(sorted(sorted(xs, key=lambda x: -x), reverse=True))
print(sorted(xs, key=lambda x: -x))

name: S5 key 调用外部函数
code:
def key_of(x):
    return 0 - x
xs = [1, 3, 2]
print(sorted(xs, key=key_of))
print(sorted(xs, key=key_of, reverse=True))

name: S6 变量持有函数
code:
f = lambda x: 0 - x
print(sorted([1, 3, 2], key=f))
